Arabic badge extracts 'Ahmed Al-Farsi / Gulf Digital LLC'. Duplicate flow: scan-duplicate panel appears with same email; clicking scan-dup-update runs and shows 'Existing lead updated' toast + scan-saved step. /leads page shows all 5 filters (leads-filter-source/event/capturedby/card/date) and the new badge lead with 'event badge scan' source pill, 'Scanned again' timestamp. /events page lists GITEX (1 lead) + TEST_iter34_event (1 lead). Mobile 430x900: /admin no overflow, nav-scan visible, scanner dialog no overflow (428=428). Tenant isolation UI: work@gmail.com /events shows empty state — no GITEX or TEST_iter34 leaked.

ui_bugs.issue: scan-save button remains ENABLED when required name field is emptied in the review step (TEST 9). Backend correctly rejects with 400 'A name is required', but the client-side validation is missing so the user only sees the error via toast on submit instead of a disabled button + inline error. Add disabled={saving || !draft.name.trim()} to scan-save, and mark scan-field-name required.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Guard scan-save with client-side name-required check: disabled={saving || !draft.name.trim()} and add aria-invalid on scan-field-name when empty. Backend already enforces 400, so this is a UX polish rather than a correctness bug.
critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.py is now 4013 lines — approaching maintenance risk. Consider splitting Events/Scanner/Followup routes into separate modules.
ScanCardDialog.jsx (446 lines) mixes camera, upload, event picker, duplicate handling and follow-up UI. Extract EventPicker + ReviewForm + SavedStep sub-components for testability.
Duplicate detection is card-scoped (find_duplicate_lead queries by cardSlug); a user with multiple cards will not see cross-card duplicates. Documented behavior — matches PRD.
scan_confirm returns 200 with ok=false when a duplicate is found — semantically fine but non-2xx would be more RESTful. Not blocking; keep as-is for UX flow simplicity.
